title: Build Beer Compass: arrow to nearest open place selling alcohol (Sydney, OSM + guessed hours)
description: Mobile web compass. OSM venues for Greater Sydney baked into data.json; opening_hours parsed, guessed by type when missing; arrow rotates with device heading (iOS webkitCompassHeading / deviceorientationabsolute) corrected by Sydney declination. Static GitHub Pages site at rt567.github.io/beer-compass/.
